name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted personal finance app for tracking accounts, net worth, budgets and transactions, with a background worker, PostgreSQL and Redis.

alerts.message: Registration is open on first start. The first account you create becomes the super admin; switch onboarding to Closed or Invite-only under Settings > Self-Hosting afterwards.

Never change the ACTIVE_RECORD_ENCRYPTION_* variables after the first start: data encrypted with them, such as provider credentials, MFA secrets and email addresses, becomes unreadable. Changing SECRET_KEY_BASE signs everyone out.
